medicinesSubtitle: Search a brand or a generic, then compare other brands and your price.
searchHint: Try a brand like Napa, or a generic like paracetamol.
noAlternatives: No other brands of this generic are in the catalog yet.
checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then log in.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setupDescription: Your account is ready. Confirm your pharmacy name to finish setup. If setup failed earlier, you can retry here.
setupError: Could not finish pharmacy setup. Please try again.
confirmationError: This confirmation link is invalid or expired. Try logging in. If your account is not confirmed, request another confirmation email below.
stockDescription: Record purchase lots and track whole packs by expiry date.
stockUnits: Quantities count whole catalog packs. Buy and selling prices are per pack. A strip of 10 tablets counts as 1 pack; a bottle counts as 1 pack. Loose-unit sales are not supported yet.
noStock: No purchase lots recorded yet. Search for a medicine to receive your first batch.
invalidBatch: Enter a batch number, a valid expiry date, a positive whole pack count, and a buy price with up to two decimal places.
saveBatchError: Could not save this purchase lot. Your stock has not been confirmed. Retry with the same details.
noBatches: No purchase lots for this medicine yet.
fefoHint: For future sales, use sellable batches in the order below: earliest expiry, then receipt time. Expired stock is excluded. No stock is deducted on this screen.
expiryHint: Use the date printed on the pack. If only a month and year are printed, enter the last day of that month. Packs become expired the day after this date in Bangladesh.
expiredReceiptHint: You can record an already expired lot for an accurate count; it will not be included in sellable stock.
confirmationSent: If this account needs confirmation, a new email has been requested. Check your inbox.
resendError: Could not request a confirmation email. Wait a moment and try again.
